tolerance.pattern: ^shellRejectsPartiallyForeignFaceList \[foreign\] -> no open face: done=1 valid=1 volume=[-0-9.eE+]+$
tolerance.reason: the same kernel non-determinism as 766-modeling-evidence-fix's offsetArc, in the same BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid family. One binary compiled once and run ten times against the pinned v4.0.0-kernel.3 asset printed -13587.492558290325, ...29, ...31 five times and ...32 three times, a relative spread of 5.2e-16, a couple of units in the last place of a double; the transcript's -13587.492558290329 is one of them. The eleven other measurements in this transcript, four of them volumes from the same probe, reproduce to the last digit every run. Declared as a tolerance rather than volatile because the volume IS the measurement: `done=1 valid=1` and every word of the label stay compared exactly, and the run prints the worst difference it saw. The cause is #3003. #2965.
